subject: general
question: In India all loans that are below __________ are considered as micro loans.
solution:
The correct answer is __**one lakh rupees.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Microloans:-**

 
 
• **These are small loans that are typically provided to low-income individuals or entrepreneurs who do not have access to traditional banking services.**
 
• The loans are typically used to start or expand a business, purchase assets, or improve living conditions.
 
• Microloans in India are provided by a variety of organizations, including banks, non-bank financial institutions (NBFCs), and microfinance institutions (MFIs).
 
• MFIs are specialized institutions that focus on providing microloans to poor and low-income individuals. 
 
• **In India, all loans that are below Rs. 1 lakh are considered as microloans. This is according to the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), the central bank of India.**
 
• The RBI defines microfinance as "the provision of thrift, credit and other financial services to low-income households and their microenterprises, mainly in rural and semi-urban areas, on a sustainable basis."
